title: allium bolanderi var. stenanthum
intro: Allium bolanderi var. stenanthum, commonly known as Bolander's onion, is a plant species in the Allium genus, characterized by its onion-like flavor and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Bolander's onion include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing the risk of various diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Bolander's onion include its ability to relieve digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit potential antiviral and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of Bolander's onion include sulfur compounds, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
